ModMetaData.name: Pocket Dimension Example
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Example mod: a buildable "dimension door" that opens a small persistent pocket map. Pawns can walk in and out; items can be hauled through. Built entirely on the vanilla 1.5+ pocket map stack (MapPortal / PocketMapExit / PocketMapUtility) — no Harmony, no DLC required.
範例 mod：可建造的「異空間門」，第一次進入時生成一張小型持久異空間地圖；小人可自由進出、物資可裝載搬入。完全站在原版 1.5+ pocket map 機制（MapPortal / PocketMapExit / PocketMapUtility）之上——零 Harmony、不需任何 DLC。
拆除異空間門時，門內的小人與物品會被安全傳送回門口，異空間地圖隨後回收。
